modules.name: Deployable Solar Array
modules.description: High-efficiency vertical solar panels placed on high-elevation rim points to maximize sunlight capture during the 14-day lunar day.
modules.citation: NASA Space Technology Mission Directorate: Lunar Surface Innovation Initiative (LSII) Surface Power.
modules.reality_vs_game: Real lunar solar arrays at South Pole can catch near-continuous illumination on select peaks of eternal light, but experience dust accumulation. In game, produces 25 kW during daytime only.

modules.name: Regenerative Fuel Cell / Battery Bank
modules.name_zh: 储能电池/再生燃料电池舱
modules.description: Stores surplus energy generated during the lunar day to power life support and heating through the 336-hour (14 Earth days) lunar night.
modules.citation: NASA STMD: Fission Surface Power & Lunar Night Energy Storage Architectures.
modules.reality_vs_game: Real missions evaluate 40 kWe nuclear fission reactors because batteries for a 14-day night are extremely heavy. Game uses modular battery banks.

modules.name: Oxygen Generation Assembly (OGA)
modules.description: Electrolyzes water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen byproduct for propellant or Sabatier feed.
modules.citation: NASA Advanced Oxygen Generation Factsheet & Marshall Space Flight Center ECLSS.
modules.reality_vs_game: OGA on ISS splits water by passing electrical current through a cell stack. Requires continuous deionized water feed.

modules.name: Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA)
modules.description: Uses thermally regenerated amine beds or zeolite molecular sieves to continuously scrub toxic metabolic CO2 from the cabin atmosphere.
modules.citation: NASA NTRS 20150021777: Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentrations for Carbon Dioxide.
modules.reality_vs_game: CDRA regenerates desiccants and adsorbent beds in alternating half-cycles. In game, continuously scrubs up to 5.0 kg CO2/day while powered.

modules.name: Water Recovery System (WRS)
modules.description: Distills wastewater, humidity condensate, and urine into ultrapure potable water, achieving a 98% closed loop.
modules.citation: NASA (2023). NASA Achieves Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station (98% recovery).
modules.reality_vs_game: Combines catalytic oxidation, reverse osmosis, and vapor compression distillation. 98% efficiency directly matches NASA's 2023 flight milestone.

modules.name: Veggie & Hydroponics Bioregenerative Habitat
modules.role_zh: 生产新鲜食物与心理支持
modules.description: Hydroponic growth chambers utilizing specialized red/blue LED spectrums to cultivate salad crops (romaine lettuce, dwarf cabbage, tomatoes).
modules.citation: NASA Science: Vegetable Production System (Veggie) & Advanced Plant Habitat (APH).
modules.reality_vs_game: Real space plants take 28-35 days from seed to harvest and provide vitamins and psychological benefits. In game, yields supplemental rations after growth cycle.

modules.name: ISRU Chemical Processing Plant
modules.role_zh: 提炼氧气、水、材料与火箭燃料
modules.description: High-temperature chemical reactor capable of carbothermal regolith reduction, ice melting, and Sabatier fuel synthesis.
modules.citation: NASA STMD: Lunar Surface Innovation Initiative (ISRU and In-Situ Manufacturing).
modules.reality_vs_game: Real ISRU plants require high temperatures (up to 1000°C for carbothermal or 800°C for MOXIE). In game, consumes high power to process mined raw materials into usable stocks.

modules.name: Regolith Berm & Storm Shelter
modules.name_zh: 月壤辐射屏蔽层/避难所
modules.role_zh: 抵御太阳粒子与宇宙射线
modules.description: A thick protective layer of sintered or bagged lunar regolith (1.5 to 2 meters) and water tanks enclosing the central crew quarters.
modules.citation: NASA SRAG FAQ & OLTARIS Space Radiation Shielding Calculations.
modules.reality_vs_game: NASA studies show 1.5 - 2.0 meters of compacted lunar regolith provides comparable shielding to Earth's atmosphere against SPEs. Game provides 75% dose reduction for sheltered crew.
